We have bulk TiO2 structure, CO2 structure. Need to generate slab from TiO2 with given Miller index (1,1,1), min slab size 12 Å, min vacuum 5 Å. Then enumerate slabs? Actually we can directly generate slab using enumerate_slabs_text which enumerates all terminations. Use that with bulk_cif, miller_index [1,1,1], min_slab_size 12, min_vacuum_size 5. Then choose slab index 0 (slab_index). Then get adsorption sites on that slab, choose ontop site index 0. Then add CO2 adsorbate at that site with height 2.0 Å. Finally write combined CIF to file and output path.

We need to use enumerate_slabs_text tool.
